name: gq-company-formation
description: Company formation in Equatorial Guinea for tax year 2026. Covers the entity types under OHADA, tax registration within 15 working days, the tax forms each company files, bookkeeping and audit report tests, and the items not yet confirmed such as minimum capital and local ownership rules. Use for questions such as how do I set up a company in Equatorial Guinea, what is the minimum capital for an SL or SA, do I need a local shareholder, how do I get an NIF, and how long does incorporation take. Applies to founders, foreign investors and advisers. Tax rules come from Ley 1/2024; OHADA and local content figures could not be read from an official text and are marked unverified.
